titulo_es.@es: Have to, don't have to y should
titulo_es.@en: Have to, don't have to and should

consejo.@es: No significa «advertir de un peligro»; eso es «warn».
consejo.@en: It doesn't mean «warning of a danger»; that's «warn».

texto.@es: **Have to** suele expresar una obligación por una norma o circunstancia externa: **I have to work tomorrow** (tengo que trabajar mañana).
texto.@en: **Have to** usually expresses an obligation for an external rule or circumstance: **I have to work tomorrow** (I have to work tomorrow).

texto.@es: Con **he**, **she** o **it** se usa **has to**: **She has to go** (tiene que irse).
texto.@en: **he**, **she** or **it** is used with **has to**: **She has to go** (you have to leave).

titulo.@es: Don't have to: no hace falta

texto.@es: **Don't have to** = no es necesario: **You don't have to come** (no tienes que venir). Puedes hacerlo, pero no es obligatorio.
texto.@en: **Don't have to** = not necessary: **You don't have to come** (you don't have to come). You can do it, but it's not mandatory.

texto.@es: **Mustn't** significa que algo está prohibido; **don't have to** indica que no hace falta.
texto.@en: **Mustn't** means that something is forbidden; **don't have to** indicates that it is not necessary.

texto.@es: **Should** + verbo base = deberías: **You should sleep more** (deberías dormir más). Negativa: **shouldn't** = no deberías: **You shouldn't eat so much sugar** (no deberías comer tanto azúcar).
texto.@en: **Should** + base verb = you should: **You should sleep more** (you should sleep more). Negative: **shouldn't** = you should not: **You shouldn't eat so much sugar** (you should not eat so much sugar).

texto.@es: **Advice** = consejo (sustantivo incontable: no tiene plural; se dice **some advice**). **Advise** = aconsejar (verbo). Acaban con sonidos distintos: **advice** con /s/ y **advise** con /z/. **I advise you to rest** = Te aconsejo descansar.
texto.@en: **Advice** = advice (noun inaccountant: no plural; it is said **some advice**). **Advise** = advise (verb). They end up with different sounds: **advice** with / s / and **advise** with / z /. **I advise you to rest** = I suggest you rest.

frases.en: I have to work late today.
frases.es: Tengo que trabajar hasta tarde hoy.

frases.en: I don't have to work tomorrow, so I can rest then.
frases.es: No tengo que trabajar mañana, así que puedo descansar entonces.

frases.en: That's good. I'll help you with dinner tonight.
frases.es: ¡Qué bien! Te ayudaré con la cena esta noche.

frases.en: Thanks. What's your advice for sleeping better?
frases.es: Gracias. ¿Qué consejo me das para dormir mejor?

frases.en: You shouldn't check your phone at night.
frases.es: No deberías mirar el móvil de noche.

frases.en: Maybe... but I can't quit checking it!
frases.es: Quizá... ¡pero no puedo dejar de mirarlo!
